target_customer: Web3 companies, DAOs and crypto-native organizations that earn or pay in crypto and stablecoins
problem: Crypto organizations manage treasuries in spreadsheets and consumer wallet dashboards, with no accounting, approvals, payroll or banking built for them.
business_model: B2B SaaS and financial services on top of multisig wallets (accounting, payments, cards, brokerage)
product_category: Crypto treasury, accounting and business banking

founders.name: Thibaut Sahaghian
previous_startups: US-regulated fintech backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia, sold to Safe (per his YC bio)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is an investment banker, founder and operator with 14 years in finance, product and technology; at Safe he led a 30-person team. Education not listed.

founders.name: Theophile Villard
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page and as co-founder (Theo Villard) in a search summary of the eFounders post; no bio found.

exit.reason: Safe acquired the source code and onboarded the senior leadership team; price undisclosed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on top of Gnosis multisig contracts with accounting dashboards, approvals and fiat on and off ramps; standard engineering with smart contract and compliance integration.

defensibility.rationale: Depended on an open multisig wallet standard and accounting features that wallet vendors could add; accounting history gave some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Safe, the wallet Multis built on, acquired the code and team in April 2024.

market_need_then: In 2020 and 2021 DeFi projects, NFT studios and DAOs held growing treasuries managed with spreadsheets; The Block and TechCrunch described demand for banking and accounting that fit crypto flows.

branding.domain_note: Owned multis.com (exact .com); no source on acquisition.

identity.voice_and_tone: Company blog posts are practical and educational about multisig wallets and crypto finance operations.

branding.community_and_virality: Press coverage of funding and Sequoia partnership post; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name echoes multisig but no source states this; brand visible mainly through funding press, nothing showing it drove growth.

pivots.to: Software layer for web3 organizations on Gnosis Safe wallets with accounting and payroll
pivots.why: TechCrunch describes the shift toward a finance software layer that organizations control; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Multis raised about 9 million dollars in seed funding in 2020 and a Sequoia led round in 2022 while building crypto treasury, accounting and banking on Safe wallets. After the 2022 to 2023 crypto downturn it ended as an acquisition of its code and leadership by Safe in April 2024, with undisclosed terms. The directory marks it Inactive, but the exit is an acquihire style soft landing rather than a stated failure, and no shutdown reason was given.
notes: multis.com returned HTTP 404 when fetched directly, though search listed pages on it. CB Insights reports $9.35M total over 6 rounds, which exceeds the two rounds recorded (about $9.2M); the remaining small round is not identified. The 2022 round label is not stated by TechCrunch so stage is other. Webrazzi and Finance Magnates also report the $7M round. Competitors left empty: the only dated rival named (Qonto, TechCrunch 2020-09) is about 15 months after the batch. Founded year 2019 per Sequoia and eFounders. Directory status Inactive reconciled with acquisition exit.
